player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Player {player_id} ukax GameOfPureStrategy khayna uñacht'ayata.
- Jumaxa 13 kartanaka A-K ukaxa; kullakaxa mayni q'araña.
- Kila p'unchay prize kartanxa ukaxa.  Mayni ukaxa kartanxa qillqaña, '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' jikxatasi ...
- Kartanxa alinxa prize ukaxa (ukhamaraki mayni q'arañata).  Jikxatasi tie ukaxa, prize ukaxa q'alaraña p'unchay qhiphañata.
- Jach'a total ukaxa 13 p'unchay qhiphañata, ukaxa jayt'asi.
